description: Look up a company (фирма) by Bulgarian EIK (ЕИК/БУЛСТАТ), EU VAT number or name via nula.bg (Commercial Register / VIES). Use it BEFORE creating an invoice or bill for a counterparty you have not seen, to get the exact legal name and VAT number. Never invent an EIK.

name.description: Company name (partial names may work for Bulgarian companies)

vat_number.description: VAT number with country prefix, e.g. BG123456789 or DE123456789

name: nula_lookup_company
title: Look up a company (ЕИК / VAT)
